title: Higher-order hyperuniformity of random measures
summary: We study higher-order hyperuniformity through the large-scale variance of local $k$-point patterns, and write $\HU_k$ for the resulting condition; $\HU_1$ is ordinary hyperuniformity. The conditions $\HU_k$ need not coincide: for every $k\geq1$ there exists an $\mathbb R$-invariant weakly mixing simple point process that belongs to $\HU_j$ for all $j\leq k$ but not to $\HU_{k+1}$.
